summary: CONMED Corp filed a Form 8-K disclosing entry into a material definitive agreement—specifically, the First Omnibus Amendment to its existing credit facility. The amendment secures a $450 million incremental senior secured delayed draw term loan facility (Term A-2 Loan Facility), maturing June 10, 2030, with interest margins based on SOFR plus 1.125%-2.25% or base rate plus 0.125%-1.25%. Proceeds will be used to repurchase a portion of CONMED's outstanding 2.25% Convertible Senior Notes due 2026 and pay related fees. This is a routine debt financing arrangement, not a special situation event.
